text:
rachel_collections: FYI SolarFlux (SF-9922) disputed usage on invoice #9922 ($94,120) citing duplicate embedding calls on 2026-02-27. They declined payment and asked for the invoice to be re-run. @amir_fin @dina_ops

billing-bot: Alert: invoice 9922 marked disputed; autopause access option available.

amir_fin: Need evidence. Send logs, request IDs, and sample payloads. If duplicate calls are our fault, we can offer a settlement or credit. If it's client replay, we should hold firm.

dina_ops: Pulled logs: there are ~1200 second-party replays from IPs we don't recognize between 02:25-02:30 UTC. Looks like client retry script misfired after a network hiccup. Marking as client-side.

sam_sales: SolarFlux argues their integration didn't change. They're pushing back hard and want to avoid service interruption 30ntegration go-live next week. Sales prefers a negotiated settlement to keep momentum.

amir_fin: Propose: 1) Accept 60% of disputed usage ($56,472) as paid now, 2) credit the remaining 40% ($37,648) as a one-time technical credit (not refundable), 3) require signed acknowledgement that replays caused the excess and add integration guardrails. Legal sign-off required.

legal-ops: Drafting an acknowledgement + credit memo. Add clause: if future replay spikes >10% of monthly baseline, we reserve right to pause ingestion. Also include indemnity language for replay-caused overages.

rachel_collections: If finance approves, we'll send settlement offer and secure first payment via wire within 5 days. Recommend removing from automated dunning while offer pending.

amir_fin: Approving conditional settlement as outlined. Conditions: payment 60% posted within 5 days, signed ack + credit memo, and Sales to confirm integration guardrails documented. If any condition fails, revert to collections and reactivate dunning.

billing-bot: Reminder: pending settlement - 60% payment due within 5 days to avoid escalation.

sam_sales: I'll get their engineering lead to sign the guardrail doc and loop internal PM.

rachel_collections: Offer sent. Customer accepted in chat and initiated a $56,472 wire. Billing portal shows incoming ACH pending. Will post update when cleared.

billing-bot: Payment update: ACH $56,472 received 2026-03-28 11:05 UTC. Applied to invoice 9922. Credit memo for $37,648 issued.

amir_fin: Mark invoice as settled with technical credit. Move account to watchlist for 90 days and flag ledger note. Thanks team.

legal-ops: Files updated with signed acknowledgement and credit memo. Closing thread unless further disputes.
